### Today’s NFL transactions (08/03)

#### Free agent signings
- **Lions signed TE Nick Muse** — Adds another tight end to the camp mix and competition for depth snaps.
- **Texans signed LB Sione Takitaki** — Gives Houston experienced linebacker depth and another option in the front seven.
- **Browns signed DT Travis Bell** — Adds defensive line depth for camp and the preseason rotation.
- **Patriots signed DL Casey Rogers** — More interior/edge depth for New England; a low-risk roster tryout type of addition.

#### Reserve/Injured moves
- **Cowboys placed Charles Snowden on Reserve/Injured from Waived/Injured (Not Against 90)** — Keeps him under team control while freeing a roster spot.
- **49ers placed Mikail Kamara on Reserve/Injured from Waived/Injured (Not Against 90)** — Same effect: roster flexibility, but Kamara is removed from active competition.
- **Commanders placed Tre Hawkins III on Reserve/Injured from Waived/Injured (Not Against 90)** — Washington preserves the player’s rights while opening space elsewhere.

#### Terminated via waivers
- **Broncos terminated Blake Cotton via waivers** — Ends his run in Denver and clears a path for other camp bodies.
- **Texans terminated Derrick Graham via waivers** — Houston moves on from another fringe roster piece.
- **Jaguars terminated Ben Patterson via waivers** — Adds to Jacksonville’s roster churn as cuts tighten.
- **Vikings terminated Kejon Owens via waivers** — Minnesota continues trimming the bottom of the roster.
- **Titans terminated Hudson Clark via waivers** — Another depth move as Tennessee sorts out the back end of the roster.

#### Waived, no recall / waived injured
- **Lions waived WR Tarik Black (No Recall)** — Detroit opens up a receiver spot; Black is now off the immediate roster path there.
- **Browns waived TJ Harden (No Recall)** — Cleveland makes another depth cut at camp.
- **Colts waived CB Cameron Mitchell (Injured, Prior to Cut to 53)** — Injury designation matters because it affects his roster status as Indy moves toward final cuts.
- **Cardinals waived Tejhaun Palmer (No Recall)** — Arizona trims a developmental player from the roster bubble.
- **Cardinals waived Coziah Izzard (No Recall)** — Another depth cut as Arizona keeps sorting the bottom of the roster.

#### Waiver claim
- **Cardinals claimed DL Cam Horsley off waivers from the Titans** — Arizona adds a defensive line piece at Tennessee’s expense; useful depth swing for both teams’ camp boards.

**Big picture:** Most of these are standard camp roster churn moves. The notable additions are **Nick Muse, Sione Takitaki, Casey Rogers, Travis Bell, and Cam Horsley**; the rest are mainly depth-clearing transactions and injury-related roster management.

### Today's injury briefing

- **Panthers WR Xavier Legette** was **carted off with an upper-body injury**.  
  **Why it matters:** He’s a key part of Carolina’s receiving plan, so any missed time would affect the WR rotation and camp evaluation.

- **Panthers TE JT Sanders** also **left practice with an ankle injury**. Dave Canales said he’s “had a great day,” but the **severity wasn’t specified**.  
  **Why it matters:** Another depth hit in Carolina’s pass-game pieces; worth monitoring if the ankle keeps him out.

- **Bears S Coby Bryant** is expected to **miss about 8-10 weeks** after a **hyperextended left knee, bone bruise, and small fracture**.  
  **Why it matters:** Chicago loses a major offseason signing in the secondary for a significant chunk of camp and likely into the early part of the season.

- **Lions RB Sione Vaki** will **miss time** after a freak practice injury that caused an **eye poke and broken nose**.  
  **Why it matters:** Depth-chart hit in Detroit’s backfield.

- **Lions TE Anthony Firkser** suffered a **fractured fibula** and will **miss significant time**.  
  **Why it matters:** That’s a meaningful loss at tight end depth.

- **Dolphins S Lonnie Johnson Jr.** will **not practice** after leaving yesterday with a **lower-body injury**; he’s **day to day**.  
  **Why it matters:** Secondary depth is temporarily thin.

- **Dolphins RT Austin Jackson** is also **day to day** and **not practicing today**.  
  **Why it matters:** O-line availability matters for camp reps and protection continuity.

- **Dolphins TE Greg Dulcich** is dealing with a **minor injury** and could return **around next week’s joint practice with Washington**.  
  **Why it matters:** This is the clearest near-return on the list.

- **Dolphins UDFA DT Rene Konga** will **miss the entire season**.  
  **Why it matters:** Depth loss, though less of a headline impact than the veteran injuries.

- **Jets rookie TE Kenyon Sadiq** had a **setback** with the offseason hernia surgery and will **miss some time**, though Aaron Glenn still expects him ready for the regular-season opener.  
  **Why it matters:** A camp setback, but not a long-term panic point.

- **Jets DE Kingsley Enagbare** was **held out as a precaution** after being stepped on yesterday.  
  **Why it matters:** Sounds minor for now.

- **Steelers WR Cole Burgess** was **waived/injured** after an apparent **knee injury**. Pittsburgh signed **WR Jakobie Keeney-James** in the move.  
  **Why it matters:** Roster churn at the bottom of the WR depth chart.

- **Cowboys TE Princeton Fant** was **carted off** after practice; the injury detail **was not specified**.  
  **Why it matters:** Any cart-off is worth monitoring, especially for a depth tight end.

- **Jamaree Salyer** is **day to day**.  
  **Why it matters:** Status is fluid, but the team/context wasn’t specified.

### Return watch
- **Greg Dulcich** is the only player with a clear near-return window: **possibly around next week’s joint practice**.  

No player was officially returned to practice today.
